0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East, 5th in the Atlantic) make their ninth trip of the 2026-27 season to face the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast), with Brooklyn sitting 1-3 on the road and riding a one-game win streak. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise), and Noah Clowney is day-to-day with knee soreness, a game-time decision who is averaging 5.4 points and 21.6 minutes in 2026-27 after 12.3 points and 27.0 minutes in 2025-26. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture), and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while Brooklyn was swept 0-4 by Atlanta in 2025-26, including a 141-107 loss in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
